title: Graph Energy Matching: Transport-Aligned Energy-Based Modeling for Graph Generation
abstract: arXiv:2603.23398v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generative modeling of discrete data, such as graphs, underpins many scientific and industrial applications, including molecular discovery and materials design. In these domains, probabilistic inference is particularly valuable, as it enables composable generation and principled incorporation of desired constraints, such as structural or functional properties. Energy-based models naturally support this goal by capturing relative likelihoods and enabling composable inference by directly enforcing constraints during inference. However, discrete energy-based models typically struggle with efficient and high-quality sampling, as off-support regions often contain spurious local minima, trapping samplers and causing training instabilities, resulting in a fidelity gap compared to discrete diffusion models. To address this gap, we introduce Graph Energy Matching (GEM), a discrete generative framework inspired by the Jordan-Kinderlehrer

translated_title: 图能量匹配：面向图生成的传输对齐能量建模方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.23398v4 公告类型：replace-cross。摘要：离散数据（如图）的生成建模是众多科学与工业应用的基础，包括分子发现与材料设计。在这些领域中，概率推断尤为宝贵，因为它支持可组合的生成，并能有原则性地融入期望的约束，如结构或功能性质。基于能量的模型通过捕捉相对似然，并允许在推断时直接施加约束，天然契合这一目标。然而，离散能量模型通常难以实现高效且高质量的采样：支持集之外的区域往往存在虚假的局部极小值，会使采样器陷入其中并导致训练不稳定，从而使其与离散扩散模型相比存在保真度差距。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了图能量匹配，一种受 Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto 输运机制启发的离散生成框架。（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出图能量匹配（GEM）框架，通过对齐输运机制来克服离散能量模型的采样陷阱与训练不稳定问题，实现可融入结构或功能约束、可组合的图生成，并缩小与离散扩散模型的保真度差距。
en_tdlr: GEM (Graph Energy Matching) is a transport-aligned energy-based framework for discrete graph generation that overcomes spurious-minima sampling and training instabilities of discrete EBMs, enabling composable, constraint-aware generation with fidelity competitive with discrete diffusion models.
